Every detail, on one page.

Tap any row to expand.

A writing space designed to disappear. Clean layout, one-time purchase, no subscription, no accounts pestering you to log in. When inspiration hits, you open the app and you write.
Type the lyric, drop a chord above the right syllable, and it stays there — even when you edit the line, transpose the song, or resize the window. No more hand-aligning chord charts.
Tune by ear with Chromatic, Guitar, Bass, Vocal or Violin modes. A = 440. Locks on fast, stays put, and works through the hum of a noisy room.
Build any chord you can imagine. Enharmonic spelling, alternate voicings, slash chords, extended harmony — every chord gets a clean diagram for the instrument you're holding.
Tap record the moment the melody shows up. Trim handles and Crop cut a take down to the part you want — ready to share, loop against, or drop into a setlist.
Drag songs into a setlist, reorder with a swipe, and carry the whole night on stage in your pocket. Keep multiple lists — one for the coffeehouse gig, one for the full band, one for the recording date.
Auto-scroll at your tempo so both hands stay on the instrument. Footswitch supportLifetime turns page-turns into pedal-taps, and the display stays legible from across the stage.
Three styles of PDF lead sheets, plus ChordPro and plain text for the nerds. Print them, email them, or pull them up on a tablet — every layout is designed to be read at a glance.
Works fully offline. Syncs through your own iCloud account — nothing is stored on a SongScribe server. No login walls, no third-party servers reading your lyrics. Your songs stay yours.
17 hand-tuned themes, light and dark, plus 5 typefaces. Make the app feel like your guitar — and switch the whole vibe in a second when the mood turns.
A native app for iPhone and iPad. Built in Swift for the device you're holding — snappy, offline, and at home with the rest of iOS.
